Name: Orientation
Title: Orientation
Summary: Reach the marked point. Management insists this counts as training.
StartAnnouncement: Welcome to Floor One. Your orientation consists of walking somewhere. We have marked it, because the last group could not manage it unmarked.
CompletionAnnouncement: Orientation complete. You walked to a place. The bar was low and you cleared it. Barely.

Name: MakeFriends
Title: Making Friends
Summary: Fist-bump an ally. The audience likes this more than the violence.
StartAnnouncement: Our data shows viewers respond to camaraderie at four times the rate of dismemberment. Go and bump a fist. This is not optional, it is content.
CompletionAnnouncement: Alliance logged. Somewhere a graph went up and a producer got a bonus. Not you. A producer.

Name: ClearTheRoom
Title: Clear the Room
Summary: Clear the encounter. Everything in it wants the same slot you do.
StartAnnouncement: There is a room. There are things in the room. Only one of those facts is negotiable, and it is not the room.
CompletionAnnouncement: Room cleared. Housekeeping has been notified and has, once again, declined to attend.

Name: GoUp
Title: Higher Ground
Summary: Climb the wall to the ledge. Ten metres will do it.
StartAnnouncement: There is a wall. Above the wall there is a ledge. Between them there is only your Constitution score and your optimism. We are broadcasting either way.
CompletionAnnouncement: You are on the ledge. The view is not better. Nothing down here has a better view. But you climbed, and that is measurable.

Name: Kitchens
Title: Health and Safety
Summary: Clear the kitchens. Watch the ticket rail.
StartAnnouncement: The kitchen is still taking orders. It should not be. The rail above the pass prints a ticket before each course arrives, which is considerably more warning than this floor is contractually obliged to give you.
CompletionAnnouncement: Kitchens clear. The rail is quiet. Somewhere a customer is still waiting to be seated, and will go on waiting.

Name: HeavyLifting
Title: Unclaimed Property
Summary: Take something heavy out of the pantry.
StartAnnouncement: Dry storage holds property unclaimed by its previous owners, who are themselves unclaimed. Take what you can lift. The word 'can' is doing a great deal of work in that sentence.
CompletionAnnouncement: Ownership transferred. The obligations attached to it transfer with it. We will detail those at a time of our choosing.

Objectives.Description: Carry something out of the pantry

Name: FloorOne
Title: Floor One
Summary: Clear every encounter on Floor One.
StartAnnouncement: All remaining encounters on this floor are now your responsibility. Production has scheduled the celebration regardless of outcome.
CompletionAnnouncement: Floor One is clear. Your contract advances to the next tier automatically and without your consent. Congratulations.

Objectives.Description: Clear every encounter on the floor
